directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for long distance concrete pump shortlist Xingtai. The row to open is /products/electric-80-concrete-pump. It prints 150 m / 500 m. Diesel 120 is the diesel row. 100 m / 300 m, beside fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Electric 60 prints fine-stone 200 m / 600 m at 90 kW. Electric 80 is the only page in that set with 900 m horizontal. HBT8018 prints conveying 150 m and delivery height 450 m at 132 kW. Diesel 120 prints 150 m / 500 m and 100 m³/h on twin 145 kW engines. 900 m on Electric 80 plus 150 m on Diesel 120 is not a catalogue distance. The long-distance note names Electric 80, Electric 60, HBT8018 and Diesel 120. A site that cannot feed 110 kW should not keep Electric 80 and drop the motor cell. Electric 80, Electric 60 and HBT8018 need the printed motors: 110 kW, 90 kW and 132 kW. For a long pipeline or a high vertical figure, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai names a shortlist: Electric 80 (900 m / 300 m, 60 m³/h), then Electric 60, HBT8018 and Diesel 120. The section title “The Bernoulli Equation” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是长距离短名单点名邢台的四张页面的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-80-concrete-pump。柴油120是柴油行。它印 150 m / 500 m。这一组里只有电动80有水平 900 m。电动60印细石 200 m / 600 m、90 kW。带不住 110 kW 的现场，不应留下电动80却删掉电机格。长距离说明点名电动80、电动60、HBT8018 和柴油120。100 m / 300 m，旁边细石是 200 m / 600 m。电动80的 900 m 加上柴油120的 150 m 不是目录距离。HBT8018 印输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、132 kW。柴油120印 150 m / 500 m、100 m³/h，双机各 145 kW。电动80、电动60和 HBT8018 需要所印电机：110 kW、90 kW 和 132 kW。管路很长或垂直数字很高时，河北品锦机械（邢台）点名一份短名单：电动80（900 m / 300 m、60 m³/h），然后是电动60、HBT8018 和柴油120。节标题「伯努利方程」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。
